name: net-b2-field-replication
title: Netcode B2: field replication (.Replicated(), Lua replicated = true, FieldKind codecs, delta vs acked baseline, NetworkTransform)
issue: Design: C:/Method Notes Obsidian/orchestrator/proposals/netcode-runtime-design.md (N1-N15 ACCEPTED): read the field replication and snapshot sections (reflection-driven replication through FieldInfo/ComponentSerializer, .Replicated() on RegisterMember, Lua 'replicated = true', per-FieldKind codecs and quantisation, delta against the last ACKED baseline, NetworkTransform, bandwidth notes) and row B2 of the stage table (line ~297), and the security rules (bounded sizes, authority checks). B1 is merged (NetworkObject, net ids, spawn/despawn replication, fingerprint, world/server/client classes in engine/src/network and n2server): read it and its tests FIRST, plus FieldInfo.hpp (FieldKind, FieldInfo built by RegisterMember(...).Range().Tooltip().AsColor()), ComponentSerializer, ComponentRegistry::Describe, ValidateFieldValue/ClampFieldValue, how Lua components expose fields (GetLuaFields kind rules), and the n2net channel layer (reliable + unreliable channels, packet layer). SCOPE: (1) a '.Replicated()' flag on field registration (C++) and 'replicated = true' in a Lua component's field declaration; the replicated field set is part of the registry fingerprint from B1 so client and server must agree (fingerprint mismatch already refuses the join: extend the fingerprint to include replicated field ids/kinds); (2) wire codecs per FieldKind (bool, ints, float with optional quantisation from Range(), Vector2/3/4, Quaternion smallest-three, color, string with a cap, enums, AssetRef by id/path hash, GameObject references by net id with a sentinel for unknown): bounded decode (every length capped before allocation), exact round-trip tests, fuzz-style malformed-input tests; (3) server-side state replication: per client a baseline of last ACKED state per object per field; each tick (or at the configured send rate from the settings) send deltas (changed fields via a bitmask) on the unreliable channel with sequence + ack, resend based on acks (no per-packet guarantees: the next delta is computed against the last acked baseline), full state on spawn and on baseline loss, interest = everything (interest management is B9); (4) client applies updates to its local objects ONLY for replicated fields and only from the server; clients can never write replicated fields of others and the server ignores any replication data from clients; authority/ownership per the design for owner-writable fields is NOT in B2 (server-only authority); (5) NetworkTransform component: replicates position/rotation/scale (quantised per settings), applied on the client directly (interpolation is B3), with a teleport flag; (6) tests on the n2net network simulator (loss, reorder, duplication, latency): convergence under loss, delta correctness against the acked baseline, bandwidth smaller than full-state resend in a scripted scenario, determinism of encoded bytes (same state => same bytes), plus the multi-process loopback integration test extension (client observes server-side field changes through N2Server with real UDP); (7) docs: the replication section of the netcode docs, scripting-lua.html (replicated = true), serialization.html (.Replicated()) verified against the code. Respect: web build must still compile (n2net core is compiled for web), no unordered iteration in encoding, one RNG draw per statement. Nothing builds locally for the engine; CI (12 checks) is the test; expect fix rounds; re-read every edit twice (CMake/YAML/C++ syntax); NEVER call a stateful function (RNG etc.) twice in one argument list or operator expression (unspecified evaluation order); NEVER run taskkill or kill other processes; verify every docs sentence against the CODE; no attribution lines on commits or PRs (no Co-Authored-By, no Generated-with footer); GitHub only via the wrapper; before your final push merge origin/master into the branch if it moved; your FINAL message must be a real report (PR number, head sha, what you did, deviations), never a single word.
acceptance: .Replicated() and Lua replicated = true; fingerprint covers replicated fields
Bounded codecs for every FieldKind with round-trip and malformed-input tests
Delta against acked baseline converges under loss/reorder/duplication on the simulator; server-only authority
NetworkTransform replicates; loopback integration extended; docs true; CI green
notes: Reviewer (security/protocol): every decode length/count bounded before allocation, client data never written to the world, baseline/ack logic cannot desync or leak memory (bounded history), codec byte-determinism, fingerprint covers what changes the wire format, quantisation round-trip error bounds, Lua replicated flag validation, web build still compiles, compile-level correctness.
